record.paper: Subdigraphs of prescribed size and outdegree

dossier_meta.paper: Subdigraphs of prescribed size and outdegree
dossier_meta.catalog_title: Open problem: closing the gap for $d(s)$
dossier_meta.statement_text: It remains an interesting open problem to close the gap between the lower and upper bounds: $\Omega(\log s) < \frac{s}{2} - d(s) < O(\sqrt{s\log s})$, where $d(s)$ denotes the largest integer such that every $2n$-vertex digraph of minimum out-degree at least $s$ contains an $n$-vertex subdigraph of minimum out-degree at least $d(s)$.
dossier_meta.context_text: After disproving Alon's problem, the authors note that the true asymptotic behaviour of $\frac{s}{2} - d(s)$ lies somewhere between $\Omega(\log s)$ (established by their construction) and $O(\sqrt{s\log s})$ (established by Alon's probabilistic argument). The precise asymptotics of $d(s)$ remain open.
